nodes.name: kubectl.go
nodes.summary: Wraps kubectl execution with the test namespace, kubeconfig and context, and formats describe output used when e2e tests fail.

nodes.name: Kubectl
nodes.summary: Holds the namespace, kubectl binary and kubeconfig/context used to invoke kubectl inside e2e tests.

nodes.name: Describe
nodes.summary: Returns kubectl describe output for the test namespace environment for failure diagnostics.

nodes.name: DescribeResource
nodes.summary: Returns kubectl describe output for a named resource as a kind/name string.

nodes.name: Kubectl
nodes.summary: Builds a Kubectl runner bound to a namespace using the framework kubeconfig and current context.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.summary: Runs kubectl with the configured namespace, kubeconfig and context, returning combined output for assertions.

nodes.name: secret.go
nodes.summary: Polls a Kubernetes Secret until cert-manager has populated its certificate data, so e2e tests can assert on issued material.

nodes.name: WaitForSecretCertificateData
nodes.summary: Waits for the named Secret to contain non-empty certificate data, failing the test once the timeout expires.

nodes.name: validate.go
nodes.summary: Helper methods that fetch issued Secrets and run validation function sets against Certificates, CertificateRequests and CertificateSigningRequests.

nodes.name: ValidateCertificate
nodes.summary: Fetches the Certificate's target Secret and applies every validation function, aggregating failures with resource descriptions.

nodes.name: ValidateCertificateRequest
nodes.summary: Fetches the issued CertificateRequest material and applies every validation function, aggregating errors.

nodes.name: ValidateCertificateSigningRequest
nodes.summary: Fetches the signed CertificateSigningRequest material and applies every validation function, aggregating errors.

nodes.name: certificaterequests.go
nodes.summary: Empty-package assertions that verify an issued CertificateRequest matches its requested subject, SANs, key usages, conditions and duration.

nodes.name: ExpectValidCertificate
nodes.summary: Asserts the CertificateRequest carries a non-empty issued certificate.

nodes.name: ExpectCertificateOrganizationToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the issued certificate's organization fields match the CertificateRequest spec.

nodes.name: ExpectValidPrivateKeyData
nodes.summary: Decodes the private key and verifies it matches the certificate public key and requested key algorithm.

nodes.name: ExpectCertificateDNSNamesToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate DNS SANs exactly match the CertificateRequest spec.

nodes.name: ExpectCertificateURIsToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate URI SANs match the CertificateRequest spec.

nodes.name: ExpectCertificateIPsToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate IP address SANs match the CertificateRequest spec.

nodes.name: ExpectValidCommonName
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate common name matches the CertificateRequest spec.

nodes.name: ExpectKeyUsageExtKeyUsageServerAuth
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate includes the server authentication extended key usage.

nodes.name: ExpectKeyUsageExtKeyUsageClientAuth
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate includes the client authentication extended key usage.

nodes.name: ExpectEmailsToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate email SANs match the CertificateRequest spec.

nodes.name: ExpectValidBasicConstraints
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate basic constraints (CA flag and path length) are as expected.

nodes.name: ExpectConditionApproved
nodes.summary: Asserts the CertificateRequest has an Approved condition set to True.

nodes.name: ExpectConditionNotDenied
nodes.summary: Asserts the CertificateRequest has no Denied condition.

nodes.name: ExpectDurationToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the issued certificate duration matches the request's requested duration within the allowed fuzz.

nodes.name: ExpectDuration
nodes.summary: Computes whether the observed certificate lifetime falls within the expected duration plus or minus fuzz seconds.

nodes.name: certificates.go
nodes.summary: Empty-package assertions that verify the Secret issued for a Certificate matches its spec, including SANs, key usages, trust chain and additional output formats.

nodes.name: ExpectValidKeysInSecret
nodes.summary: Asserts the target Secret contains the private key and certificate entries cert-manager is expected to write.

nodes.name: ExpectValidAnnotations
nodes.summary: Asserts the Secret's annotations include those defined by the Certificate secret template.

nodes.name: ExpectValidPrivateKeyData
nodes.summary: Decodes the private key from the Secret and verifies it matches the certificate public key and requested algorithm.

nodes.name: ExpectValidCertificate
nodes.summary: Parses the issued certificate and asserts it is valid for the requested DNS name and not expired.

nodes.name: ExpectCertificateOrganizationToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate's subject organization entries match the Certificate spec.

nodes.name: ExpectCertificateDNSNamesToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate's DNS SANs match the Certificate spec exactly.

nodes.name: ExpectCertificateURIsToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate's URI SANs match the Certificate spec.

nodes.name: ExpectCertificateIPsToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate's IP address SANs match the Certificate spec.

nodes.name: ExpectValidCommonName
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate's common name matches the Certificate spec.

nodes.name: ExpectValidNotAfterDate
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate's notAfter falls within the Certificate's requested duration window.

nodes.name: ExpectKeyUsageExtKeyUsageServerAuth
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate includes the server authentication extended key usage.

nodes.name: ExpectKeyUsageExtKeyUsageClientAuth
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate includes the client authentication extended key usage.

nodes.name: ExpectKeyUsageUsageDigitalSignature
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate key usage includes digital signature.

nodes.name: ExpectKeyUsageUsageDataEncipherment
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate key usage includes data encipherment.

nodes.name: ExpectEmailsToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate's email SANs match the Certificate spec.

nodes.name: ExpectCorrectTrustChain
nodes.summary: Asserts the issued certificate verifies against the CA bundle stored in the Secret's ca.crt entry.

nodes.name: ExpectCARootCertificate
nodes.summary: Asserts the CA certificate in the Secret is a valid root for the issued certificate.

nodes.name: ExpectConditionReadyObservedGeneration
nodes.summary: Asserts the Certificate's Ready condition reports the current observed generation.

nodes.name: ExpectValidBasicConstraints
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate basic constraints (CA flag and path length) are as expected.

nodes.name: ExpectValidAdditionalOutputFormats
nodes.summary: Asserts the Secret contains the requested additional output formats (combined PEM, DER) of the certificate and key.

nodes.name: ExpectDurationToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate duration matches the Certificate spec within the allowed fuzz.

nodes.name: ExpectDuration
nodes.summary: Computes whether the observed certificate lifetime falls within the expected duration plus or minus fuzz seconds.

nodes.name: certificatesigningrequests.go
nodes.summary: Empty-package assertions that verify a signed CertificateSigningRequest matches its requested subject, SANs, key usages, conditions and duration.

nodes.name: ExpectValidCertificate
nodes.summary: Asserts the CertificateSigningRequest carries a non-empty issued certificate.

nodes.name: ExpectCertificateOrganizationToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the signed certificate's organization fields match the CertificateSigningRequest spec.

nodes.name: ExpectValidPrivateKeyData
nodes.summary: Verifies the private key and issued certificate public keys match, honouring the requested key algorithm.

nodes.name: ExpectCertificateDNSNamesToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate DNS SANs exactly match the CertificateSigningRequest spec.

nodes.name: ExpectCertificateURIsToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate URI SANs match the CertificateSigningRequest spec.

nodes.name: ExpectCertificateIPsToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate IP address SANs match the CertificateSigningRequest spec.

nodes.name: ExpectValidCommonName
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate common name matches the CertificateSigningRequest spec.

nodes.name: ExpectDurationToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the signed certificate duration matches the request duration within the allowed fuzz.

nodes.name: ExpectDuration
nodes.summary: Computes whether the observed certificate lifetime falls within the expected duration plus or minus fuzz seconds.

nodes.name: ExpectKeyUsageExtKeyUsageServerAuth
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate includes the server authentication extended key usage.

nodes.name: ExpectKeyUsageExtKeyUsageClientAuth
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate includes the client authentication extended key usage.

nodes.name: ExpectKeyUsageUsageDigitalSignature
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate key usage includes digital signature.

nodes.name: ExpectKeyUsageUsageDataEncipherment
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate key usage includes data encipherment.

nodes.name: ExpectEmailsToMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate email SANs match the CertificateSigningRequest spec.

nodes.name: ExpectValidBasicConstraints
nodes.summary: Asserts the certificate basic constraints (CA flag and path length) are as expected.

nodes.name: ExpectConditionApproved
nodes.summary: Asserts the CertificateSigningRequest has an Approved condition set to True.

nodes.name: ExpectConditionNotDenied
nodes.summary: Asserts the CertificateSigningRequest has no Denied condition.

nodes.name: ExpectConditionNotFailed
nodes.summary: Asserts the CertificateSigningRequest has no Failed condition.

nodes.name: validation.go
nodes.summary: Builds the validator lists used by e2e tests, skipping checks for certificate features the target issuer does not support.

nodes.name: CertificateSetForUnsupportedFeatureSet
nodes.summary: Returns the Certificate validators to run, omitting checks whose features the issuer does not support.

nodes.name: CertificateRequestSetForUnsupportedFeatureSet
nodes.summary: Returns the CertificateRequest validators to run for the given unsupported feature set.

nodes.name: CertificateSigningRequestSetForUnsupportedFeatureSet
nodes.summary: Returns the CertificateSigningRequest validators to run for the given unsupported feature set.

nodes.name: log.go
nodes.summary: Thin logging facade over the Ginkgo writer that adds timestamps and offers an exponential-backoff logger for noisy polling loops.

nodes.name: Logf
nodes.summary: Writes a timestamped, level-tagged formatted log line to the configured writer.

nodes.name: LogBackoff
nodes.summary: Returns a logger that drops repeated messages while an exponential backoff timer is active.

nodes.name: have_condition_matcher.go
nodes.summary: Gomega matcher that waits for a resource to report a given condition, mapping typed conditions (Certificate, Issuer, etc.) through generic accessors.

nodes.name: conditionMatcher
nodes.summary: Gomega matcher holding the expected condition and resource-to-condition extractor.

nodes.name: HaveCondition
nodes.summary: Builds a matcher asserting a resource eventually reports the expected condition.

nodes.name: toGenericCondition
nodes.summary: Normalises a typed condition into a generic type/status/reason struct.

nodes.name: getUpToDateResource
nodes.summary: Re-fetches the object being matched so the matcher evaluates the latest condition state.

nodes.name: extractConditionSlice
nodes.summary: Uses reflection to pull the Conditions slice out of a typed cert-manager resource.

nodes.name: Match
nodes.summary: Implements the Gomega matcher, polling until a condition matches or the timeout elapses.

nodes.name: matches
nodes.summary: Compares expected and actual generic conditions, honouring unspecified fields.

nodes.name: buildGenericCondition
nodes.summary: Constructs a generic condition from a condition type, status and reason.

nodes.name: FailureMessage
nodes.summary: Renders the failure message describing the conditions actually observed.

nodes.name: NegatedFailureMessage
nodes.summary: Renders the failure message for a negated condition assertion.

nodes.name: san_matchers.go
nodes.summary: Gomega matchers that compare the SAN extension of an issued certificate against expected DNS, IP, URI and email entries.

nodes.name: SANMatcher
nodes.summary: Gomega matcher holding the expected subject alternative name extension.

nodes.name: HaveSameSANsAs
nodes.summary: Builds a matcher comparing a certificate against the SANs of another certificate.

nodes.name: SANEquals
nodes.summary: Builds a matcher comparing a certificate SAN extension against an expected extension.

nodes.name: Match
nodes.summary: Parses the certificate and compares its SAN extension with the expected one, order-independently.

nodes.name: sortGeneralNamesByTagBytes
nodes.summary: Sorts ASN.1 general names by tag and bytes so SAN comparisons are order-insensitive.

nodes.name: extractSANsFromCertificate
nodes.summary: Parses a DER certificate and extracts its subject alternative name extension.
